about: Everything the four apps ship that isn't this project's own code. legal/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md is generated from this file by scripts/legal/notices.py (never edit it by hand). License texts are in legal/licenses, copied unmodified from each component's source archive, package or repository at the shipped version.

components.name: FFmpeg
components.use: The separate ffmpeg and ffprobe programs (Contents/Helpers on macOS, the ffmpeg folder on Windows). Not linked into the apps. Built LGPL-only (no --enable-gpl, no --enable-nonfree) by scripts/ffmpeg/ in this repository, which pins and checksums every source archive; the same sources and scripts are attached to each release.

components.name: LAME
components.use: MP3 encoder, built into the FFmpeg programs.

components.use: Opus audio codec, built into the FFmpeg programs.

components.name: libogg
components.use: Ogg container, built into the FFmpeg programs.

components.name: libvorbis
components.use: Vorbis audio codec, built into the FFmpeg programs.

components.name: libvpx
components.copyright: Copyright (c) 2010, The WebM Project authors. All rights reserved.
components.use: VP8/VP9 video codec, built into the FFmpeg programs.

components.copyright: Copyright (c) 2010, Google Inc. All rights reserved.
components.use: WebP image codec, built into the FFmpeg programs.

components.name: SVT-AV1
components.use: AV1 encoder (AVIF output), built into the FFmpeg programs.

components.name: zlib
components.use: Compression, built into the Windows FFmpeg programs.

components.name: MinGW-w64 runtime
components.version: as shipped with the build toolchain
components.license: ZPL-2.1 (with parts in the public domain or under BSD or LGPL, as marked)
components.use: C runtime startup code, linked statically into the Windows FFmpeg programs. libgcc is linked statically too, under the GCC Runtime Library Exception 3.1 (https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gcc-exception-3.1.html), which places no conditions on the programs.

components.name: Space Grotesk
components.copyright: Copyright 2020 The Space Grotesk Project Authors (https://github.com/floriankarsten/space-grotesk)
components.use: Brand typeface for the wordmark and brand moments (onboarding, About).

components.name: .NET runtime
components.use: The Windows apps are self-contained: the .NET runtime ships inside each app folder.

components.name: Windows SDK projection for .NET (Microsoft.Windows.SDK.NET, WinRT.Runtime)
components.use: Lets the Windows apps call Windows APIs. Shipped by every .NET app that targets Windows.

components.name: Windows App SDK
components.license: Microsoft Software License Terms, Windows App SDK (distributable code)
components.use: WinUI 3 and the app lifecycle, notifications and windowing APIs; self-contained, so its files ship in each app folder.

components.name: Microsoft Edge WebView2 SDK
components.copyright: Copyright (C) Microsoft Corporation. All rights reserved.
components.use: A dependency of WinUI 3 that ships with it. Potion and Potion Dropper don't show web content.

components.name: Windows ML runtime
components.license: Microsoft Software License Terms, Windows ML Runtime
components.use: A dependency of the Windows App SDK that ships with it. Potion and Potion Dropper don't use machine learning.

components.name: Open XML SDK
components.use: Reads and writes DOCX documents (Windows).

components.name: Html Agility Pack
components.use: Reads HTML and EPUB documents (Windows).

components.name: PdfPig
components.use: Reads PDF text for PDF to document conversions (Windows).

components.name: PDFsharp and MigraDoc
components.copyright: Copyright (c) 2001-2026 empira Software GmbH, Troisdorf (Cologne Area), Germany
components.use: Writes PDF files and edits PDF pages (Windows). Pinned to 6.2.4, the last MIT release.

components.name: Microsoft .NET libraries
components.use: Support libraries used by the document engines and the Windows App SDK.
